title: Remove Scene Prefixes
description: elements scene: Remove the Scene prefix whenever you can.
summary: Removed redundant Scene prefixes from the elements scene package where names are already scoped by the package. Renamed scene exports/helpers/components to shorter names such as Canvas3D, ObjectItem, Vortex, Tie, FixtureV1, LodKind, lodCanvasProps, parseFixtureV1, and blockedVortexFullIdsFromTies. Updated topology scene imports to alias the shorter package exports back to scene-specific names only at board/scene integration boundaries. Updated the scene e2e console guard for the renamed pseudoZoomFromOrbitDistance helper.
